instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\part.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\fixture.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv in SolidCAM. Use C:\Users\User\Desktop\fixture.step as fixture or avoidance geometry while machining the top pocket on C:\Users\User\Desktop\part.step. Every low-level toolpath point must remain at least 3 mm clear of the fixture. Tool definition: T1 is an 8 mm end mill for the top pocket. Write the required output file(s) to the Desktop using exactly these absolute paths: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-10.nc. [Software] SolidCAM runs inside SOLIDWORKS; start SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` first (adjust path).
